defects.title: Planted residue file in product-out/ not detected by comparator-only check
defects.description: NC-12 planted a residue file (NC12-planted-residue.txt) into the product-out/ subtree of a disposable copy of QLB-EXT-009. The comparator produced agree/product_agreement because it verifies only that declared retained_output_refs match their expected digests — it does not fail on undeclared extra files. The design expected the offline verifier (which computes retained-tree digests) to catch this, but the offline verifier is product code and was not available in the completion run.
defects.impact: The comparator alone cannot detect extra files planted in the retained workspace tree. The offline verifier (product-side) provides this check. This is a known limitation documented in the claim ceiling: the campaign's comparator-only check does not guarantee tree-level integrity.
defects.resolution: Not a product defect. This is a scope limitation of the campaign's comparator tooling vs the full offline verification pipeline. The claim ceiling already acknowledges this. NC-12's FAILED status is recorded honestly.
